About AABI: AABI is the only non-profit aviation accrediting organization in the world. To date, AABI has accredited numerous aviation schools that stand out with their quality of education all over the world, including Embry–Riddle Aeronautical University, Purdue University, and the University of North Dakota. The AABI is recognized by the Council for Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA) in the United States and by YÖKAK in Turkey.
